# Templates

Copy-pasteable, genericized starting points for running a project with an assistant. They
belong to [Level 3](../level-3-starter-kit.md), but you can grab any one on its own.

Everything in brackets like `[fill this in]` is a blank for you to complete. None of these
contain any real lab data; they are skeletons.

| File | What it is | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| [`CLAUDE.md`](CLAUDE.md) | House rules an assistant follows every session. | Top of your project folder. |
| [`AGENT_BRIEF.md`](AGENT_BRIEF.md) | One-page front door: situation, canonical files, rules that cost the most time. | Top of your project folder. |
| [`decision-log-template.md`](decision-log-template.md) | One dated file per decision or work session. | `docs/log/YYYYMMDD_topic.md` |
| [`chat-context-pack.md`](chat-context-pack.md) | Small summary to paste at the start of a chat if you have no file access. | Keep it handy, re-paste each conversation. |

## How to copy one

On the website, open the file and copy the text. On GitHub, open the file and click the
**Raw** button for clean plain text, then select all and copy. Paste it into a new file in
your own project (or into your chat, for the context pack) and fill in the brackets.

You do not need to understand every line before using these. Start with `AGENT_BRIEF.md`, fill
in what you can, and leave the rest for when you need it.
